title.en: Hear honorifics and a reason-clause boundary

teaching.ko: 오시니까에는 주체 높임 -시-와 이유 연결 -(으)니까가 있어요. 선생님이 오시니까 / 먼저 준비해요처럼 이유와 다음 행동의 경계를 들어요. 평서·요청을 말끝까지 듣고 구별해요. 억양 능력 전체를 평가하는 과제는 아니에요.
teaching.en: In 오시니까, -시- honors the subject and -(으)니까 gives a reason. Listen for the boundary between the reason and next action, and distinguish a statement from a request by its ending. This does not assess overall intonation ability.
teaching.de: In 오시니까 ehrt -시- das Subjekt, während -(으)니까 einen Grund nennt. Höre die Grenze zwischen Begründung und nächster Handlung und unterscheide Aussage und Bitte an der Endung. Die gesamte Intonationsfähigkeit wird damit nicht bewertet.
